import numpy as np
import torch
from actuator import Actuator
from teacher import stage, stage_cost
from solution import heat, lift, policy_cost
torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float64)
zp = torch.tensor([[0.2, 0.4], [-0.6, 1.2]])
w = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(1.7))
net = lambda v: w * (v[:, :1]**2 + 2*v[:, 1:])
s = dict(C=13., G=4., time_scale_min=3., time_origin_min=-7., y_shift_C=8., y_scale_K=20., Ta_C=12.)
res = heat(net, zp, s)
z, p = zp[:, :1], zp[:, 1:]
dy = 13*20*2*z/180 + 4*20*(z*z+2*p)
assert torch.allclose(res, w*dy + 4*(8-12) - 1000*p)
assert torch.allclose(torch.autograd.grad(res.sum(), w)[0], dy.sum())
assert heat(net,zp,{}) is None
s = dict(a=.71,b=-.34,c=1.51,d=-.23,g=.37)
rng = np.random.default_rng(4)
for n in [1, 2, 9]:
    initial = rng.normal(size=3)
    increments = rng.normal(size=n)
    uut = Actuator(s,*initial[:2])
    expected = [uut.step(u) for u in initial[2]+np.cumsum(increments)]
    F, P = lift(s,n)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(F@initial+P@increments, expected)
cfg = dict(N=5,beta=.27,a=.8,b=-.56,limit=1.2,center=.4,scale=1.7,q=1.3,r=.2,s=.5,discount=.86)
X, R, U = [[.3,3.9],[-.2,.3],[-.6,-.2]]
tensors = [torch.tensor(v).reshape(-1,1) for v in (X,R,U)]
def oracle(weight,coupled):
    total=0
    for state, reference, previous in zip(X,R,U):
        for k in range(cfg['N']):
            nxt,applied=stage(lambda v:weight*v[0]+.17*v[1],state,reference,previous,cfg)
            if coupled: nxt += .05*state+.23*applied
            total += cfg['discount']**k*stage_cost(nxt,reference,applied,previous,cfg)
            state,previous=nxt,applied
    return total/len(X)
for coupled in (False,True):
    actor = lambda v:w*v[:,:1]+.17*v[:,1:]
    perception = lambda v:.05*v[:,:1]+.23*v[:,1:]
    value = policy_cost(actor,perception,*tensors,cfg,coupled)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(value.item(),oracle(w.item(),coupled))
    dw = torch.autograd.grad(value,w)[0].item()
    eps = 1e-6
    refdw = (oracle(w.item()+eps,coupled)-oracle(w.item()-eps,coupled))/(2*eps)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(dw,refdw,rtol=1e-6,atol=1e-7)
print('all checks passed')
